Widget family: MENU / DROPDOWN POPUP

Strict visual criteria (PASS only if ALL hold):

1. A floating rectangular menu/popup surface is visible with a clear border and solid face.
2. Stacked item rows with readable labels are present inside the popup.
3. When separators are claimed: thin horizontal divider lines appear between item groups (not full blank gaps only).
4. FAIL if: no popup panel, no item rows, missing claimed separators, or items overflow the chrome chaotically.
